summary: Built 1941 about 25 km east of Ignace, used until 1969, then dismantled and rebuilt at Ignace in 1991, where a fire tower exhibit now stands by the library.

facts.status_note: The tower stands at Ignace after its 1991 move. No source read describes the original Bonheur site today.

access.note: The marker and fire tower exhibit are on the south side of the Ignace Public Library, reached from Main Street. The marker page does not say the tower can be climbed.

facts.agency: Ontario Department of Lands and Forests

events.note: Built about 25 km east of Ignace on land obtained in a swap with the Canadian Pacific Railway; cost $1500.00 for materials and ranger labour.
Marker says the tower was used until 1969, with successive towermen.
Dismantled at the Bonheur site and reconstructed at Ignace. The Ontario still-standing list records it at Ignace as removed from Bonheur Township.
Marker says the tower was originally 80 ft high and was reconstructed at 66 ft.

corrections.proposed: relocated 1991: dismantled at the Bonheur site and reconstructed at Ignace
corrections.why: The current event text is garbled and gives no year. The marker gives 1991 for the dismantling and rebuilding, and the Ontario list records the move from Bonheur Township.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The OSM record (standing) and the survey record (relocated) describe the same tower. It was moved in 1991 and now stands at Ignace.

sources.title: Bonheur Fire Tower: Dismantling and Erection (agreement)

notes_for_editor: The 1941 build, the 1969 end of use and the 1991 move rest on the HMDB marker (one source, a local history). The Township of Ignace agreement is undated in the copy read, so it supports the rebuild but cannot date it. The marker also says the tower was rebuilt at 66 ft (about 20 m), which matches the OSM height of 20 m. Do not confuse this with the separate Ignace-town tower in the Ignace Driftwood 2010 article (first tower 80 ft, 1930; a 1964 replacement). The canada-lookouts Ignace page has no tower text, and firelookout.ca is a JavaScript index with no readable record. No source read says whether the public can climb the exhibit tower.
